documents.title: How do I create an account?
documents.question: How do I create an account?
documents.body:
How do I create an account?

Click on the "Sign Up" button in the top right corner of the homepage. Fill in your email, password, and select "Customer" as your role. Verify your email address to complete registration.

documents.title: How do I place an order?
documents.question: How do I place an order?
documents.body:
How do I place an order?

Browse products, add items to your cart, then proceed to checkout. Select your payment method (Paystack), enter shipping details, and complete the payment. You'll receive an order confirmation via email.

documents.title: How can I track my order?
documents.question: How can I track my order?
documents.body:
How can I track my order?

Go to your Dashboard > Orders. Click on any order to see its current status. You can also track order updates through email notifications.

documents.title: How do I become a vendor?
documents.question: How do I become a vendor?
documents.body:
How do I become a vendor?

Register an account and select "Vendor" as your role. Complete your profile, set up your store, and submit your store for verification. Our team will review your application within 1-2 business days.

documents.title: How do I add products?
documents.question: How do I add products?
documents.body:
How do I add products?

Navigate to your Vendor Dashboard > Products. Click "Add Product", fill in product details, upload images via Cloudinary, set pricing and stock, then publish.

documents.title: How are vendor payouts calculated?
documents.question: How are vendor payouts calculated?
documents.body:
How are vendor payouts calculated?

Vendors receive 100% of the product price minus platform commission (if applicable) and payment processing fees. When there is no open dispute, vendors receive payouts within 2 business days. If a dispute is being settled, the platform decides when the payout is released.

documents.title: What payment methods do you accept?
documents.question: What payment methods do you accept?
documents.body:
What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit/debit cards, mobile money, and bank transfers through Paystack, our secure payment processor.

documents.title: How do I request a refund?
documents.question: How do I request a refund?
documents.body:
How do I request a refund?

Contact the seller directly through your order page to initiate a refund request. If unresolved, our support team can assist. Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days after approval. Depending on your bank, the credit may take 10-14 business days to appear in your account.

documents.title: Why was my payment declined?
documents.question: Why was my payment declined?
documents.body:
Why was my payment declined?

Payment declines can occur due to insufficient funds, incorrect card details, or bank security flags. Please verify your information or contact your bank. You can also try an alternative payment method.

documents.title: How long does delivery take?
documents.question: How long does delivery take?
documents.body:
How long does delivery take?

Delivery times vary by seller location and shipping method. Standard delivery typically takes 3-7 business days. You'll receive tracking information once your order ships.

documents.title: What if my order arrives damaged?
documents.question: What if my order arrives damaged?
documents.body:
What if my order arrives damaged?

Take photos of the damaged items and contact the seller immediately through your order page. If the seller doesn't respond within 48 hours, our support team will intervene.

documents.title: Why is my store verification taking long?
documents.question: Why is my store verification taking long?
documents.body:
Why is my store verification taking long?

Verification typically takes 1-2 business days. Delays may occur if additional documentation is needed. Check your email for updates or contact support.

documents.title: What documents are required for verification?
documents.question: What documents are required for verification?
documents.body:
What documents are required for verification?

We require a valid government-issued ID (passport, driver's license, or national ID) and proof of business registration if applicable. Business licenses may be required for certain product categories.

documents.title: How do I become a featured vendor?
documents.question: How do I become a featured vendor?
documents.body:
How do I become a featured vendor?

Featured vendor status is awarded to top-performing stores with excellent customer ratings, fast shipping, and high-quality products. Admin may also feature vendors manually based on merit.

documents.title: What are the benefits of being featured?
documents.question: What are the benefits of being featured?
documents.body:
What are the benefits of being featured?

Featured vendors receive premium placement on the marketplace, increased visibility, a special badge on their store, and access to promotional opportunities.

documents.title: How do I reset my password?
documents.question: How do I reset my password?
documents.body:
How do I reset my password?

Click "Forgot Password" on the login page. Enter your email address and follow the reset link sent to your inbox. The link expires in 1 hour.

documents.title: How do I update my profile information?
documents.question: How do I update my profile information?
documents.body:
How do I update my profile information?

Log in and go to Dashboard > Settings. You can update your name, phone, address, and profile picture there.

documents.title: How do I delete my account?
documents.question: How do I delete my account?
documents.body:
How do I delete my account?

Deleting your account is permanent. Your personal data is removed where permitted. Audit logs and records the platform is legally required to keep are retained. To request deletion, contact support.

documents.title: The website is not loading properly. What should I do?
documents.question: The website is not loading properly. What should I do?
documents.body:
The website is not loading properly. What should I do?

Try clearing your browser cache, disabling browser extensions, or using a different browser. If the issue persists, try accessing the site from a different device or contact support.

documents.title: I can't upload product images. Help!
documents.question: I can't upload product images. Help!
documents.body:
I can't upload product images. Help!

Ensure your images are in JPG, PNG, or WebP format and under 10MB. If uploads still fail, check your internet connection or try a different browser. Contact support if the problem continues.

documents.title: I'm not receiving email notifications.
documents.question: I'm not receiving email notifications.
documents.body:
I'm not receiving email notifications.

Check your spam folder first. Ensure you've added our email address to your contacts. Verify your email address in account settings. If issues persist, contact support to update your email.

documents.title: Account Creation Process
documents.body:
Creating an Account
Complete guide to registering on Dhream Market
## Account Creation Process

### Step 1: Navigate to Registration

Click the "Sign Up" button in the top right corner of the homepage or visit /register directly.

### Step 2: Enter Email and Password

Enter your email address and create a secure password. Your password must be at least 8 characters.

### Step 3: Select Account Type

Choose "Customer" if you want to shop on our marketplace. Vendors should select "Vendor" for selling.

Check your inbox for a verification email and click the link to confirm your account.

### Phone Number

Add a valid phone number for delivery updates and order notifications.

documents.title: Step-by-Step Process
documents.body:
Placing Orders
Complete guide to ordering products on Dhream Market
## Step-by-Step Process

### Step 1: Browse Products

Navigate to the Marketplace and use search or filters to find products. You can filter by category, price range, and vendor location.

### Step 2: View Product Details

Click on any product to view detailed information, images, pricing, and vendor details before making your selection.

### Step 3: Add to Cart

Select quantity and click "Add to Cart". You can continue shopping or proceed to checkout immediately.

### Step 4: Review Cart

Click the cart icon to review your items, adjust quantities, or remove products before checkout.

### Step 5: Proceed to Checkout

Click "Checkout" to enter shipping details and select your payment method through Paystack.

### Step 6: Complete Payment

Choose from Mobile Money, Credit/Debit Card, or Bank Transfer. Complete payment to confirm your order.

documents.title: Payment Methods Available
documents.body:
Making Payments
Secure payment guide for Dhream Market
## Payment Methods Available

Dhream Market uses Paystack for secure payment processing. All payments are processed securely with industry-standard encryption.

### Mobile Money

Pay directly from your MTN, Vodafone, or AirtelTigo mobile money wallet. Funds are deducted instantly.

### Credit/Debit Cards

Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and other major cards accepted. Your card details are securely processed by Paystack.

### Bank Transfer

Choose direct bank transfer for manual payment. Follow the provided instructions to complete your transfer.

documents.title: Payment Security
documents.body:
Making Payments

All payments are processed through Paystack with PCI-DSS compliance and 256-bit SSL encryption.

Your payment information is never stored on our servers. We do not have access to your card details.

## Order Status Meanings

- Pending: Order placed, awaiting vendor confirmation
- Processing: Vendor is preparing your order for shipment
- Shipped: Order is on the way with tracking available
- Delivered: Order has been received by the customer
- Completed: Order finalized after delivery confirmation

Preorder items are products that will be available in the future. They allow vendors to gauge demand and ensure adequate stock.

When you place a preorder, you'll be charged immediately and the item will ship once it arrives at the vendor's warehouse.

Backorder items are temporarily out of stock but will be restocked soon. This allows you to reserve items in advance.

When you place a backorder, you'll be charged immediately and the item will ship once inventory is replenished.

Refund and Return Policy
Understanding our return and refund processes. Last Updated: 8th September, 2026
## Overview

This Refund and Return Policy outlines the guidelines for returning products and requesting refunds on the Dhream Market marketplace. We aim to provide a fair and transparent process for all customers while respecting vendor policies.

documents.title: Eligibility for Returns
documents.body:
Refund and Return Policy
Understanding our return and refund processes. Last Updated: 8th September, 2026
## Eligibility for Returns

Products may be returned under the following circumstances:

- Product does not match the description or images on the listing
- Product is damaged or defective upon arrival
- Wrong item was received (different product than ordered)
- Product is significantly different from what was expected
Returns must be initiated within 3 days of receiving the product. The product must be in its original condition with all packaging and tags intact.

documents.title: Non-Returnable Items
documents.body:
Refund and Return Policy
Understanding our return and refund processes. Last Updated: 8th September, 2026
## Non-Returnable Items

The following items are not eligible for return:

- Personal care and hygiene products that have been opened or used
- Digital products and downloadable content
- Items specifically marked as "final sale" or "non-refundable"
- Products damaged due to misuse or improper care
- Items returned after the 3-day window
- Products without proof of purchase

documents.title: Return Process
documents.body:
Refund and Return Policy
Understanding our return and refund processes. Last Updated: 8th September, 2026
## Return Process

### Step 1: Initiate Return

Contact the vendor directly through your order to initiate a return request. Provide your order number, a description of the issue, and photos if applicable.

### Step 2: Return Approval

The vendor will review your request and approve or reject it within 3 business days. Approved returns will include instructions for returning the item.

### Step 3: Ship the Item

Ship the item back to the vendor using a tracked shipping method. Keep the tracking number and shipping receipt for your records.

### Step 4: Refund Processing

Once the vendor receives and inspects the returned item, the refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. The refund will be credited to your original payment method.

Terms and Conditions
Platform usage terms and conditions. Last Updated: 8th September, 2026
## Marketplace Payment Processing & Vendor Payout Policy

This policy outlines how payments are processed and vendor payouts are handled on Dhream Market.

### Payment Processing

- All customer payments made on Dhream Market are processed through Dhream Market's centralized Paystack account.
- Vendors/store owners do NOT receive payments directly from customers at the point of checkout.
- Dhream Market will aggregate and reconcile completed sales for each vendor/store before payouts are made.
- Vendor payouts will be sent based on completed and verified sales.
- Paystack transaction charges/fees are deducted by Paystack before payout settlement.
### Deductions and Adjustments

Vendor payouts may also reflect:

- Refunds
- Disputes
- Chargebacks
- Platform commissions
- Other authorized deductions
### Payout Controls and Holds

Dhream Market reserves the right to:

- Determine payout schedules
- Payout holding periods
- Settlement timelines
- Fraud review processes
- Compliance checks
### Vendor Responsibilities

- Vendors are responsible for ensuring their payout banking details are accurate.
### Payout Holds

Dhream Market may temporarily hold payouts in cases involving:

- Suspicious activity
- Fraud investigation
- Disputes
- Policy violations
- Compliance reviews

## Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on our platform.

### Types of Cookies We Use

- Necessary Cookies: Essential for the website to function properly. These enable core functionalities like page navigation and access to secure areas. Cannot be disabled.
- Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website. Search interactions are tracked in aggregate (without storing raw search queries) to improve our platform. Information is reported anonymously.
- Marketing Cookies: Used to track visitors across websites to deliver personalized advertisements relevant to your interests.
You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some features of our platform. When you first visit our site, you'll see a cookie consent banner where you can manage your preferences.

Behavioral Tracking: We track items you view to personalize recommendations. You can opt out of this tracking at any time in your account settings under Wishlist Preferences.
